Only the .woff2 faces are vendored (every current browser takes woff2 first;
the .woff / .ttf fallbacks named in katex.min.css are not shipped). Nothing
else of the package (src/, contrib/, cli.js) is used. Per-file sha256 sums:
SHA256SUMS (check with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` in this directory).

To update: fetch the new tarball from the registry, compare its sha1 / sha512
with the registry's dist.shasum / dist.integrity, replace the files above,
regenerate SHA256SUMS, and record the new version here.

Font licence (slot 22 WP-LIC2, 2026-10-06): FONTS-LICENSE-OFL.txt is NOT from the package (the package ships only the MIT LICENSE); it was written
here from the licence statement embedded in the name table (nameID 0 / 13 / 14) of the .ttf faces of katex 0.16.47 (npm, found locally in a
node_modules tree), whose 20 .woff2 files are byte-identical (cmp) to the 20 vendored 0.19.0 files: SIL OFL 1.1, (c) 2009-2010 Design Science,
Inc., (c) 2014-2018 Khan Academy, Reserved Font Names KaTeX_*. The vendored 0.19.0 .woff2 carry no readable name strings.
